what: @samconnerone (Circle/Arc): someone should build a trusted rating system for DeFi protocols and tokens covering security, liquidity, decentralization, audits, token concentration, history, governance, yield sustainability.

why_us: Sales-intel gap для non-sales founders. Live X/LinkedIn search vs stale databases.

what: Capterra subscription-fatigue research: 42% canceled a plan in last 90 days; 65% of cancelers said too expensive; 38% would cancel on any price hike; 80% prefer tiered/flexible pricing.
